site.name: slack
site.summary: slack-clone Clone of the Slack marketing + pricing multi-page site. Pages | File | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `index.html` | Home: hero ("Made for people. Built for productivity."), product demo animation, customer logos, product modules (Channels / Huddles / Canvas / Workflow / AI), customer stories | | `pricing.html` | Pricing: four columns Free / Pro / Business+ / Enterprise+, yearly / monthly toggle, feature comparison table (message history, Slack Connect, Workflow Builder, AI, Support, etc.), FAQ | | `features.html` | Feature detail page: modules for Channels / Canvas / Clips / Huddles / Workflows / AI |

run_plan.goal: Exhaustively explore the Slack marketing site with emphasis on the pricing journey, plan comparison, and adjacent conversion paths into contact, sign-in, and account creation, while validating feature, solutions, enterprise, trust, and resource pages in both desktop and mobile viewports.
run_plan.summary: Start from the home page and treat pricing as the primary flow: verify the pricing page, billing toggle, plan cards, feature comparison, category filters, FAQ, and outbound conversion links. Then follow adjacent paths into get started, sign in, contact sales, enterprise, features, solutions, trust, and resources to confirm cross-page consistency and recovery routes. Because the prescan shows many small tap targets and mostly link-driven navigation, repeat the most important interactions on mobile and look for spacing/tap issues as part of the critique.
assumptions: The site is a static multi-page marketing clone with no authenticated backend, so form actions and CTA flows may end in confirmation states rather than real account creation.
The pricing page's billing toggle and feature filters are functional client-side controls worth deeper validation because they are the main interactive elements on the key page.
The visible headers and footer links are the main navigation system; no hidden menus or dialogs were observed in the prescan.
The many 'small tap target' warnings on desktop suggest the mobile pass should explicitly verify hit area usability on navigation and CTA links.
risk_hotspots: pricing.html: yearly/monthly billing toggle and pricing amounts
pricing.html: compare all features table and category buttons (All, Productivity, AI)
pricing.html: FAQ section and plan CTAs (Get started free, Contact sales)
contact.html: required lead form fields, select controls, checkbox consent, submit success state
signin.html: email/password form, SSO buttons, forgot password link, create account link
get-started.html: work email form and provider continue buttons
features.html: anchored feature sections (#channels, #ai, #integrations) and 'See plans & pricing' link
solutions.html: department cards and repeated 'Learn more' links
enterprise.html and trust.html: sales/security conversion links and compliance messaging
Mobile viewport: top nav and footer/footer-like links with known small tap targets

phases.title: Baseline navigation and pricing entry
phases.objective: Confirm the global nav and primary entry points from the home page into pricing, features, enterprise, contact sales, and get started.
key_checks: Open Pricing from the top nav and verify the page title and default monthly/annual state.
From the home page, click the prominent CTAs 'Get started free' and 'Talk to sales' and confirm they land on the expected account/signup and contact pages.
Use the home page feature links (Channels, AI, Workflow Builder, integrations, See pricing) to confirm anchor navigation into features/pricing.
Check that top navigation stays consistent across pages and that back navigation returns to the correct source page.
exit_criteria: Pricing page and both conversion CTAs have been reached at least once.
At least one anchor-based feature link from the home page has been exercised successfully.
No broken navigation or unexpected load errors observed in these primary entry paths.

phases.title: Pricing depth validation
phases.objective: Validate the core pricing decision flow, including plan presentation, billing toggle, comparison controls, and FAQ content.
key_checks: Switch between monthly and annual billing and verify displayed prices and any savings messaging update correctly.
Inspect each plan column: Free, Pro, Business+, Enterprise+; confirm CTA labels and plan differentiators are coherent.
Exercise the compare-all-features section and category filters (All, Productivity, AI) and verify table content changes or filtering behavior.
Open FAQ items and confirm expand/collapse behavior if present.
Test plan-level conversion links, especially 'Get started free' and 'Contact sales', for expected destinations.
exit_criteria: Both billing states have been checked.
All visible pricing controls on the page have been exercised at least once.
Feature comparison and FAQ behavior have been validated with no state glitches.

phases.title: Conversion and recovery flows
phases.objective: Stress the adjacent account and lead flows that a pricing visitor might use when ready to convert or when needing help.
key_checks: On get-started, type a work email and verify the Continue button transitions to the 'Check your email' state or equivalent confirmation.
Verify the alternate sign-in provider buttons on get-started and sign-in pages are visible and behave sensibly as non-password options.
On sign-in, test the email/password form, the Google/Microsoft buttons, 'Create an account', and 'Forgot your password?' links.
On contact sales, fill required fields, choose dropdown values, test the consent checkbox, and submit to confirm the thank-you state.
exit_criteria: Each of the three conversion/recovery pages has had its primary form or CTA exercised.
At least one success/confirmation state has been observed.
Any validation requirements or disabled-state behavior have been recorded.

phases.title: Feature and solution discovery
phases.objective: Check whether the marketing content and deep links accurately represent the product areas that feed the pricing decision.
key_checks: On features, jump to #channels, #ai, and #integrations and verify section content matches the anchor labels from the home page.
Exercise the visible feature-category links on features (Collaboration, Project Management, Integrations, Intelligence) and compare their destinations or scroll behavior.
On solutions, click representative department links such as Engineering, IT, Customer Service, Sales, Marketing, HR, and Security to confirm they route or reveal expected content.
On enterprise and trust, inspect sales and security CTAs and verify messaging aligns with enterprise readiness and compliance claims.
exit_criteria: At least three anchor/section targets on features have been validated.
At least four solution department links have been exercised.
Enterprise and trust pages have each had their primary CTA and one secondary link inspected.

phases.title: Resources and brand/support breadth
phases.objective: Validate the broader support and content ecosystem links that appear in the navigation/footer areas.
key_checks: On resources, open Help Centre, What's New, Developers, Community, Blog, and Partners links or cards to verify their behavior.
On about, inspect the mission/story/careers content and test the open positions and relevant adjacent links.
Confirm footer/category links are consistent with the top navigation and do not lead to dead ends.
Return to the main pages after each deep link to ensure site-wide navigation remains stable.
exit_criteria: The main resources cards/links have been exercised.
About page content has been reviewed and at least one career or team-related link checked.
No navigation regressions or mismatched destinations observed.

phases.title: Mobile regression pass
phases.objective: Repeat the critical conversion and pricing checks in mobile viewport to catch tap-target and responsive layout issues.
key_checks: Verify top nav usability on mobile, especially Features, Pricing, Sign in, Talk to sales, and Get started free.
Repeat the pricing toggle, plan CTA, and compare/filter interactions on mobile.
Repeat one form flow on mobile (preferably contact sales or get started) to confirm fields, selects, and submit controls remain usable.
Check that anchored links and small text links do not become impossible to tap or misaligned on narrow widths.
exit_criteria: Critical pricing and conversion interactions have been repeated on mobile.
Tap-target issues are logged where present, especially on nav and inline links.
Responsive layout appears functional enough to support the primary flow.

coverage_targets.pages: visit all known HTML pages, with deeper interaction on pricing.html, contact.html, signin.html, get-started.html, features.html, solutions.html, enterprise.html, trust.html, resources.html, and about.html
coverage_targets.features: exercise most visible controls on key pages, including pricing toggle, pricing filters, FAQ items, form inputs/selects/checkboxes, and representative deep links
coverage_targets.mobile: repeat the primary pricing path and at least one conversion form on mobile viewport, then spot-check nav/footer tap targets across key pages

notes: Prescan showed no console or network errors, so the run should focus on interaction/state coverage and responsive usability rather than error recovery from failed loads.
Many links are repeated in header and footer; prioritize unique destinations and stateful controls first, then verify duplicate navigation only as needed for consistency.

observation.title: Slack Features – Team Collaboration Tools
observation.visible_text: slack Features Solutions Enterprise Pricing Sign in Talk to sales Get started free One platform for your entire workday All the features of Slack work together so you can too. Collaboration Project Management Integrations Intelligence Collaboration Bring people, projects, knowledge and culture under one roof. # Channels Collaborate in real time with transparent conversations. Create channels around teams, projects or anything else. SC Slack Connect Turn partners into team members and break down boundaries, with secure collaboration right in Slack. H Huddles Work together in real time through audio and video meetings, including screen sharing. C Clips Share audio ideas or screen recordings with clips — all without leaving Slack. M Messaging Chat with your team in real time. Share files, react with emojis, and keep conversations organised. E Enterprise Scale securely with features designed for large organisations with complex needs. Project Management Keep projects on track without leaving the conversation. T Templates Start any task fast with ready-to-use templates. On Enterprise+, publish custom templates for your company. Ca Canvas Create rich, flexible docs with text, files, images and videos directly in a Slack canvas. L Lists Collaboratively manage projects and organise tasks in Slack lists. Track progress without switching tools. F File Sharing Bring files into the flow of work. Share, comment and collaborate on documents without leaving Slack. Integrations & Automation Connect your tools and automate your workflows. 2.6K Apps & Integrations Choose from over 2,600 apps in the Slack App Directory — from Salesforce, Jira, Google Drive, ChatGPT and more. WF Workflow Builder Automate routine tasks and processes directly in Slack, no coding required. Build with drag-and-drop simplicity. AP Agentic Platform Customise, extend and unify your tech stack in Slack. Deploy custom functions on Slack's secure infrastructure. CS Custom Workflow Steps Let developers bring org-specific systems into workflows with Slack APIs and custom steps. Intelligence Tap into your company's collective knowledge to work smarter. AI Slack AI Catch up instantly with channel and thread summaries, schedule daily recaps and take huddle notes automatically. SB Slackbot Your personal AI agent for work that knows you and your team. It adapts to your style, finds what you need and helps get work done faster. AF Agentforce Ask an agent to analyse customer data, draft emails, provide recommendations on sales opportunities and more. ES Enterprise Search Search all your company's third-party apps, data sources and conversations from a single, AI-powered search bar. WG AI Workflow Generation Build workflows from a single prompt with the power of Slack AI and Workflow Builder combined. DR Daily Recaps Get a daily digest of what's happening across all of your teams and projects, delivered right to you. Ready to get started? Try Slack free — no credit card required. observation.title: Trust & Security – Slack
observation.visible_text: slack Features Solutions Enterprise Pricing Sign in Talk to sales Get started free Trust & Security Security isn't just a feature — it's the foundation of everything we build. Data Encryption All data is encrypted in transit using TLS 1.2+ and at rest using AES-256. Your conversations and files are protected at every layer. Compliance Certifications Slack maintains SOC 2 Type II, SOC 3, ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, and CSA certifications. We also support HIPAA and FedRAMP compliance. Enterprise Key Management Control your own encryption keys with Slack EKM, powered by AWS KMS. Revoke access to data at any time with full audit trails. Data Loss Prevention Native DLP scans messages and files in Slack Connect to prevent sharing of confidential, malicious or personally identifiable content. Identity & Access SAML-based SSO, SCIM provisioning, two-factor authentication, session management and domain claiming keep your workspace secure. Privacy Principles We don't sell your data. We don't use customer data to train AI models. Your data belongs to you, and we provide tools to manage it. Privacy & Terms Privacy Policy How we collect, use and protect your personal information when you use Slack services. Terms of Service The agreement between you and Slack governing your use of our platform and services. Cookie Policy How we use cookies and similar technologies to provide, customise and improve our services. Data Processing Our data processing addendum for customers who need to comply with GDPR and other regulations. Security questions? Our team is here to help with your security and compliance needs. observation.title: Slack Features – Team Collaboration Tools
observation.visible_text: slack Features Solutions Enterprise Pricing Sign in Talk to sales Get started free One platform for your entire workday All the features of Slack work together so you can too. Collaboration Project Management Integrations Intelligence Collaboration Bring people, projects, knowledge and culture under one roof. # Channels Collaborate in real time with transparent conversations. Create channels around teams, projects or anything else. SC Slack Connect Turn partners into team members and break down boundaries, with secure collaboration right in Slack. H Huddles Work together in real time through audio and video meetings, including screen sharing. C Clips Share audio ideas or screen recordings with clips — all without leaving Slack. M Messaging Chat with your team in real time. Share files, react with emojis, and keep conversations organised. E Enterprise Scale securely with features designed for large organisations with complex needs. Project Management Keep projects on track without leaving the conversation. T Templates Start any task fast with ready-to-use templates. On Enterprise+, publish custom templates for your company. Ca Canvas Create rich, flexible docs with text, files, images and videos directly in a Slack canvas. L Lists Collaboratively manage projects and organise tasks in Slack lists. Track progress without switching tools. F File Sharing Bring files into the flow of work. Share, comment and collaborate on documents without leaving Slack. Integrations & Automation Connect your tools and automate your workflows. 2.6K Apps & Integrations Choose from over 2,600 apps in the Slack App Directory — from Salesforce, Jira, Google Drive, ChatGPT and more. WF Workflow Builder Automate routine tasks and processes directly in Slack, no coding required. Build with drag-and-drop simplicity. AP Agentic Platform Customise, extend and unify your tech stack in Slack. Deploy custom functions on Slack's secure infrastructure. CS Custom Workflow Steps Let developers bring org-specific systems into workflows with Slack APIs and custom steps. Intelligence Tap into your company's collective knowledge to work smarter. AI Slack AI Catch up instantly with channel and thread summaries, schedule daily recaps and take huddle notes automatically. SB Slackbot Your personal AI agent for work that knows you and your team. It adapts to your style, finds what you need and helps get work done faster. AF Agentforce Ask an agent to analyse customer data, draft emails, provide recommendations on sales opportunities and more. ES Enterprise Search Search all your company's third-party apps, data sources and conversations from a single, AI-powered search bar. WG AI Workflow Generation Build workflows from a single prompt with the power of Slack AI and Workflow Builder combined.
